comment: GYM GATE WIRING, gym 6 (Sabrina, Saffron Gym) - see gym_gate_kanto_gym_3_surge.json's comment for the wiring contract (full record in data/gym_gate_triggers.json). The gate consumes saffron_access + silph_co_cleared from data/gym_requirements.json's kanto_gym_6_sabrina record, both set by data/events/silph_co_liberation.json when the Silph Co. occupation is lifted by play. badge_count is host-supplied step data (live GLOBAL badge count), as in the gym 3 script. Sabrina's intro and post-battle advice lines are exact bank labels (group SaffronGym); her badge/TM grant lines (_SaffronGymSabrinaReceivedMarshBadgeText, _SaffronGymSabrinaReceivedTM46Text) belong to the host's record_gym_win flow, not to this gate script.
